name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-backlinks
description: Quartz 5 component: the pages that link to a page, public ones first, each private one marked with a lock drawn when the site builds. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: the component's vnodes must be the host's Preact's. The types are imported for types only.
//dependencies: @chaoticgoodcomputing/icons draws the private mark while the site builds, with Iconify's packages, which can't all be inlined (svgo, under @iconify/tools, reads its data files at run time). So they stay out of dist/ and install here, at exactly the library's versions, which build.mjs checks (libs/icons/docs/adr/0001). MDI is one of them, pinned exactly, and by the workspace's lock: nothing is fetched.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/, inlining our libraries, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check checks the stylesheet against ADR-0003 before it ships, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside each entry (build.mjs). The libraries are `workspace:*` specs, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005). tags-core is a library, not the quartz-tags engine, so inlining it adds no plugin dependency.

quartz.name: cgc-backlinks
quartz.description: The pages that link to a page, public ones first, each private one marked with a lock.
